gui.jei.item.ammunition_forge.info:
The Ammunition Forge casts ingots into musket balls. Place a material ingot and a musket ball mold in the forge, and fuel it like a furnace.
The mold is not consumed. Higher tier molds (Basic, Advanced, Master) are required for harder materials, and can be obtained from the Gunsmith.
gui.jei.item.astral_crystal.info:
Astral Crystals can be used in a sorcery process with the right setup to create Astral Ingots.
A 3x3 base of Lapis Lazuli and Redstone blocks must be formed, with the crystal placed in the center. The Lapis must form an X shape, with the Redstone filling the gaps.
Ingredients may be inserted by right-clicking the crystal, and a catalyst is dropped onto it, completing the process.
The crystal will be consumed in the process.
gui.jei.item.barrel_tap.info:
Barrels can be used to ferment certain items, such as wheat, into alcohol.
Place a sufficient amount of a fermentable item into a barrel, and right-click the barrel tap with an empty bottle to fill it.
gui.jei.item.piston_crushing.info:
Pistons can be used to crush certain blocks into other items.
Place a piston facing down onto a block and activate it. The yield of each crushing process may vary.
gui.jei.item.star_forge.info:
The Star Forge is a multiblock structure used for smelting endgame materials.
To build the structure, create a 3x3 floor of Star Forge Bricks. The next layer is a ring of bricks with a Star Forge Controller in the front, then another ring of bricks. Add Iron Bars on the corners, and another ring of bricks above. In the center of the topmost layer, place a Solar Lens.
When the structure is complete, the controller will report that it is active.
gui.jei.item.tesla_synthesizer.info: The Tesla Synthesizer is used to create Electric Ingots, eliminating the need to search for Abandoned Factory structures to find them.
